subject: Hosted API — monthly volume snapshot, budget band & peak TPS
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API — monthly volume snapshot, budget band & peak TPS

Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — helpful to see BrightPay's top-level flows. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the numbers we discussed and a few follow-ups so we can align the hosted pricing options. Please confirm the items in bold below and attach anything I missed.

Quick summary (notes from call):
- Primary use: live payroll Q&A + webhook-based paystub generation (chat completions + occasional long form).
- Average prompt + completion tokens: ~800 tokens per request (you mentioned a ~600 prompt / ~200 completion split).
- Expected monthly volume (ballpark): 2.5M–6M tokens/month — you said early months will be on the low end, growth to peak over Q1.
- Peak TPS: ~120 requests/sec sustained bursts (we asked about 1–2 minute bursts up to 200, you clarified safety caps on your side).
- Embeddings: light usage for search (~100k tokens/month) — not material to compute band today.

As next steps we need these confirmations to produce a hosted pricing estimate and suggested SLAs:
1) Finalize a realistic monthly token range you want quoted (please pick a conservative and an aggressive number).
2) Confirm expected peak TPS (sustained and burst) and whether the 200 req/sec is a hard ceiling.
3) Budget target: do you have a target $/1M tokens you want us to aim for in the proposal? If not, tell us your target monthly spend.
4) Procurement timeline & PO/contact for contracting (if procurement needs to be included on the quote).

I'm attaching the token-profile CSV I mentioned (brightpay_token_profile.csv) — if you can attach the endpoint-level breakout (requests/sec by endpoint + avg tokens) that will let us produce a per-route costing.

We'll propose two hosted options:
- Standard hosted (no reserved capacity) with autoscaling and pay-as-you-go unit pricing.
- Committed slab (3–12 month commit) with discounted $/1M bands and a soft SLA for latency.

Marissa and Markus are looped in to finalize the bands and check whether any Dedicated capacity recommendations make sense for the burst profile.

Thanks — feel free to reply inline or attach the endpoint breakdown when ready.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachment: brightpay_token_profile.csv (CSV — per-endpoint sample tokens + timestamped sample traffic)
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightpay.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: David Lin <david.lin@brightpay.com>, procurement@brightpay.com
Date: 2026-10-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API — monthly volume snapshot, budget band & peak TPS

Hi Olga — great recap, thanks for writing this up. Confirmations below and I've attached an endpoint breakout.

Confirmations: 
- Monthly tokens: realistic baseline ~3M tokens/month, optimistic growth to ~7M by end of Q1. For quoting, please size both 3M and 7M bands.
- Average tokens/request: we've rechecked logs — median is ~780, mean ~810, safe to use 800 as you did.
- Peak TPS: our current traffic engineering says sustained peaks ~120 rps, occasional short bursts (~90s) up to 220 rps when payroll runs trigger higher usage. 220 is a short spike — not sustained.
- Embeddings: negligible for initial rollout — include a small line item (100–200k tokens/month).
- Budget: our finance lead suggested a target of $15–18 / 1M tokens for hosted in the first 12 months (we can consider higher discounts for a multi-quarter commit). If you can show a committed slab at or below $14 / 1M that would be compelling.
- Procurement timeline: target to sign PO by end of November. Procurement contact is procurement@brightpay.com (cc'd).

Attached: brightpay_traffic_by_endpoint.xlsx — it contains per-endpoint request distribution, avg tokens, and a 7-day peak sample.

Next for us: please send a hosted pricing estimate with two bands (pay-as-you-go and 3-month commit discount) and a short note on how Redwood handles burst headroom and fallbacks to smaller models if we exceed capacity. Also call out any guardrails you'd recommend for spikes (connection throttles, token truncation).

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Platform | BrightPay
elaine@brightpay.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API — monthly volume snapshot, budget band & peak TPS

Thanks Elaine — this is great and the breakout is exactly what we need. A couple of follow-ups / clarifications from the Redwood pricing side: 

1) Unit assumptions: we'll run estimates using 800 tokens/request as the baseline you confirmed. We'll produce $/1M buckets for: 3M, 5M, and 7M monthly volumes and show the committed slab (3- and 12-month).

2) Burst & headroom: suggested approach:
   - For hosted, we size to sustained TPS with a small autoscale headroom (~25%). For the short 220 rps spikes you mentioned, we recommend an explicit burst policy and/or a short-term reserved pool (burst credits) to avoid throttling.

3) Embeddings: we will include a small embeddings line; it won't materially change the $/1M bands.

4) Recommended target: given BrightPay's $15–18 range, we'll show a pay-as-you-go baseline around $19–22 / 1M (no commit) and a committed 12-month band that can drop below $14 / 1M for the 7M slab. We'll highlight where latency SLOs are stronger on dedicated / committed lanes.

Marcos (ops) and I will draft a 1-page pricing sheet and a short appendix on burst handling. Olga — can you confirm whether BrightPay expects any PII-processing carveouts (e.g., on-prem for certain payroll workflows) or whether hosted is fully acceptable for the initial rollout? That will affect contractual language.

I'll attach a recommended pricing band PDF (redwood_pricing_band.pdf) with the initial numbers; Olga / Markus please review before we send.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — quick note from the tech side.

We are comfortable starting on hosted assuming the following are in the contract:
- Standard SOC2 + data retention controls (we'll send the questionnaire).
- Clear escalation path for peaks >200 rps and an agreed fallback (smaller model or queued requests) if headroom is exhausted.

Procurement should have an internal PO ready by 2026-11-30 provided pricing bands look sensible. Please include procurement@brightpay.com on the formal quote.

Also: Elaine asked me to copy a DocuSign link to speed signature when the quote is accepted: https://docusign.com/link/brightpay-rdw-23871 (for tracking).

I'll defer to Redwood on the recommended slab that keeps us under $14 / 1M for committed 12-months — that will be the primary decision lever.

-David
